_notes: slot values map to templates.json block ids. shoulderSafe: 'yes' = neutral/tucked/no overhead, 'caution' = usable with reduced ROM or moderate load, 'no' = skip when shoulder flagged sore. repRange and sets are defaults, generator overrides from template. video = verified demo link, shown first time an exercise appears.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.cue: Elbows tucked ~45 degrees. 3-4 sec eccentric. Stop an inch above chest, no overstretch.

chest.name: Neutral-Grip Incline DB Press
chest.cue: Palms face each other the whole set. Most shoulder-friendly incline press you own.

chest.name: Incline DB Squeeze Press
chest.cue: Press the dumbbells together hard the entire set. Constant inner-chest tension.

chest.name: Incline Barbell Press
chest.cue: Elbows tucked. Touch high on the chest, do not bounce. Stop 1 inch short if shoulder talks.

chest.name: Low-Incline DB Press (15 deg)
chest.cue: Shallow bench angle shifts load to mid-chest and unloads the front delt.

chest.name: DB Floor Press
chest.cue: Triceps touch the floor and pause. Hard stop protects the shoulder. Your safest press.

chest.name: Flat DB Bench Press
chest.cue: 3-4 sec down. Elbows at 45. Do not let the dumbbells drop below chest line.

chest.name: Neutral-Grip Flat DB Press
chest.cue: Palms in, elbows tight to ribs. Neutral grip, full send.

chest.name: Decline DB Press
chest.cue: Decline angle takes the shoulder out of the movement almost entirely.

chest.name: Band-Resisted Push-Up
chest.cue: Band across the upper back. Scapula free to move, which the bench never allows.

chest.name: Cable Crossover Low-to-High
chest.cue: Sweep up and in toward the collarbone. Soft elbow, never let the cable pull you into a stretch.

chest.name: Cable Crossover High-to-Low
chest.cue: Hands meet at the belt buckle. Squeeze 1 sec. Stop the stretch at chest width.

chest.name: Pec Deck
chest.cue: Set the start pins IN so the shoulder never opens past chest width.

chest.name: DB Pullover
chest.cue: Controlled ROM only. Stop when the arms reach forehead level, do not reach for the floor.

chest.name: Svend Press
chest.cue: Crush two plates together and press straight out. Pure inner-chest burn, zero joint stress.

chest.name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
chest.cue: One side at a time lets you control the stretch precisely. Cross past midline.

chest.name: Resistance Band Fly
chest.cue: Band tension is lowest at the stretch, highest at the squeeze. Joint-friendly by design.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.cue: Chest to fist height, not floor. Every rep explosive on the way up.

chest.name: Plyo Push-Ups
chest.cue: Land soft with bent elbows. Sub in regular push-ups at 15+ if shoulder is sore.

chest.name: Med Ball Chest Pass
chest.cue: Explosive throw from the chest. Keeps elbows in and never loads overhead.

chest.name: Deficit Push-Up (small ROM)
chest.cue: Hands on dumbbells. Go only to chest-at-hand-level, no deeper.

arms.name: Seated Incline DB Curl
arms.cue: Arms hang behind the torso. Longest head stretch you can get. No swing.

arms.name: EZ Bar Curl
arms.cue: Angled grip spares the wrist. Elbows pinned to the ribs the whole set.

arms.name: Drag Curl
arms.cue: Drag the bar UP your torso, elbows travel back. Zero front-delt involvement.

arms.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
arms.cue: Face away from the stack, arm behind you. Constant tension through the stretch.

arms.name: Hammer Curl
arms.cue: Neutral grip throughout. Hits brachialis, which pushes the bicep peak up.

arms.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
arms.cue: Curl across toward the opposite pec. Alternate arms, no rest between.

arms.name: Spider Curl
arms.cue: Chest on an incline bench, arms straight down. Zero cheating possible.

arms.name: Zottman Curl
arms.cue: Curl up supinated, rotate at the top, lower pronated slow. Bicep and forearm in one.

arms.name: Concentration Curl
arms.cue: Elbow braced on the inner thigh. Squeeze hard at the top for 1 sec.

arms.name: Preacher Curl Machine
arms.cue: Fixed path means you can push to true failure safely. Rest-pause the last set.

arms.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
arms.cue: Hands shoulder-width, elbows glued to the ribs. 3-4 sec eccentric.

arms.name: DB JM Press
arms.cue: Half skull crusher, half press. Elbows tucked, dumbbells toward the collarbone.

arms.name: Tate Press
arms.cue: Elbows flared out, dumbbells lower to the chest. All triceps, no shoulder.

arms.name: DB Floor Skull Crusher
arms.cue: Floor limits the ROM for you. Neutral grip, lower beside the ears.

arms.name: Overhead DB Extension
arms.cue: MODERATE load only. Elbows tucked, limited ROM. Stop the second the shoulder speaks.

arms.name: Cable Overhead Rope Extension
arms.cue: Cable keeps tension even. Lean forward so the shoulder angle stays shallow.

arms.name: Single-Arm Cable Extension
arms.cue: Neutral grip, elbow tight to the body. Full control over your own ROM.

arms.name: Wrist Curl
arms.cue: Forearms on the thighs. Let the weight roll to the fingertips, then curl closed.

arms.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
arms.cue: Palms down. Lighter than you think. Extensors are what prevent elbow pain.

arms.name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
arms.cue: Bar behind the glutes. Better stretch than the bench version.

arms.name: Farmer's Walk
arms.cue: Heaviest dumbbells you can hold. Shoulders packed down, walk tall.

arms.name: Plate Pinch Hold
arms.cue: Pinch two plates smooth-side-out. Pure thumb and grip work.

arms.name: Band Finger Extension
arms.cue: Band around all five fingers, open the hand. Balances all the gripping.

arms.name: Tricep Pushdown
arms.cue: Elbows pinned. Drop set the final set: strip 30 percent, go again to failure.

arms.name: Rope Pushdown
arms.cue: Spread the rope apart at the bottom. Hold the contraction 1 sec.

arms.name: Bench Dips (small ROM)
arms.cue: SMALL ROM ONLY. Elbow bends to 90 max, never lower. Protects the shoulder.

arms.name: Cable Tricep Kickback
arms.cue: Peak contraction at full extension. Light weight, strict form.

arms.name: Band Pushdown
arms.cue: Accommodating resistance, hardest at lockout. Burn-out set.

legs.name: Barbell Tempo Squat
legs.cue: 4 sec down, 1 sec pause, drive up. Bar low, elbows down to spare the shoulder.

legs.name: Box Squat
legs.cue: Sit back to the box, pause, explode. Teaches hip drive and saves the knees.

legs.name: Front Squat
legs.cue: Use a cross-arm grip, not a clean grip, to keep the shoulder out of it.

legs.name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat
legs.cue: Heels on plates. Upright torso, all quad. Great opener before heavy work.

legs.name: Zercher Squat
legs.cue: Bar in the elbow crease. Zero shoulder rotation required. Brutal core work.

legs.name: Barbell RDL
legs.cue: Hinge, do not squat. Bar drags the thighs. Stop at mid-shin.

legs.name: Dumbbell RDL
legs.cue: Neutral grip, dumbbells outside the legs. Deeper stretch than the bar allows.

legs.name: Single-Leg RDL
legs.cue: Hips square. Balance forces the glute med to work overtime.

legs.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
legs.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down. Squeeze 1 sec at lockout.

legs.name: Good Morning
legs.cue: Light load, big stretch. Hamstrings and spinal erectors.

legs.name: Leg Press (Bilateral)
legs.cue: High foot placement for hams and glutes. Drop set on the last set.

legs.name: Single-Leg Press (Right)
legs.cue: Foot centered on the platform. Match what the left side can do, not more.

legs.name: Single-Leg Press (Left)
legs.cue: Same weight and reps as the right side. Note any gap in the log.

legs.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
legs.cue: Rear foot on the bench, dumbbells at the sides. Front shin vertical. Mandatory every legs day.

legs.name: Nordic Curl
legs.cue: Lower as slow as you can control, push off to reset. Elite eccentric hamstring work.

legs.name: Walking Lunge
legs.cue: Long stride for glutes, short stride for quads. Neutral grip dumbbells.

legs.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
legs.cue: Drive through the heel on the bench. Do not push off the floor leg.

legs.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
legs.cue: Front foot on a plate. Extra ROM through the glute.

legs.name: Sissy Squat
legs.cue: Knees travel forward, hips stay extended. Pure rectus femoris.

legs.name: Leg Extension
legs.cue: Bilateral, then single right, then single left. Drop set the bilateral finish.

legs.name: Leg Curl
legs.cue: Bilateral, then single right, then single left. Rest-pause the bilateral finish.

legs.name: Hip Adductor Machine
legs.cue: Squeeze the knees together, 1 sec hold. Control the opening.

legs.name: Hip Abductor Machine
legs.cue: Lean forward slightly to bias the glute med. Slow return.

legs.name: Seated Calf Raise
legs.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, 2 sec squeeze at the top. Bent knee hits the soleus.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raise
legs.cue: Straight knee targets the gastroc. Pause at the bottom, no bouncing.

legs.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
legs.cue: Toes on the bottom edge of the platform. Heavy load, controlled tempo.

legs.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
legs.cue: One dumbbell, hold a rack for balance. Exposes side-to-side gaps.
